description: The file is an HTML webpage implementing a front-end interface for visualizing database structures and data. It contains UI components and embedded JavaScript code that fetches data from backend APIs to display databases, tables, and table data, with features like refresh, expand cells, and responsive layout.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables, and triggers loading of tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and displays it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML to display table data with support for wide content and expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expand capability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded view for a cell to show full content.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays a placeholder indicating no data is available.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active styling for UI elements based on selection.
